title_zh: 剧场小册子大规模字体统计对比分析
title_en: Theatre Chapbooks At Scale: A Statistical Comparative Analysis of Typography
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种统计方法，用于量化历史印刷书籍之间字体的相似性，助力文献学分析。方法通过聚类和对齐自动提取的字符图像，定义任意两书字体距离，并采用统计框架判断距离的显著性。该方法应用于17世纪西班牙戏剧小册子的文献学研究，能够自动比较不同书籍中的罗马体和斜体，经专家验证，发现了新的印刷者归属并修正了旧归属，显著提升了数字书目学的规模和效率。
summary_en: We propose a statistical method quantifying typeface similarity between historical printed books to accelerate philological analysis. By clustering and aligning automatically extracted character images, it defines a typeface distance between any two books and uses a statistical framework to assess significance. Applied to 17th-century Spanish theatre chapbooks, the method enables automatic comparison of Roman and Italic types, leading to new printer attributions and revisions confirmed by experts. This advances digital bibliography beyond previous scale limits.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究利用自动化统计方法突破了传统人工视觉鉴定的瓶颈，实现了大量历史印刷物字体的高效比较与分析，为数字书目学提供了广阔应用前景。
why_it_matters_en: The study overcomes traditional manual inspection limits by automating font similarity comparison across numerous historical prints, enhancing philological research and expanding digital bibliography capabilities.

title_zh: OVEarth-Bench：评估开放词汇地球观测的类别广度和查询多样性
title_en: OVEarth-Bench: Evaluating Category Breadth and Query Diversity for Open-Vocabulary Earth Observation
summary_zh: 开放词汇地球观测（EO）旨在通过自然语言定位地理空间概念，而非固定标签集。现有基准通常覆盖类别词汇狭窄或查询形式有限。为填补此空白，OVEarth-Bench扩展了类别广度，涵盖广泛的层级类别及正负表达，并丰富了查询多样性，包括词汇、指代和推理查询。基准支持统一的零样本掩码和框定位评估。评测显示：（1）当前方法性能有限，类别覆盖更广模型排名更稳定；（2）基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的方法整体表现最佳；（3）EO专用方法通常落后于通用模型且难以挑战最强方法。该研究为未来开放词汇EO方法设计提供了指导，强调开发更现实、多样、高质量和大规模基准的重要性。数据和评测工具已公开。
summary_en: Open-vocabulary Earth Observation (EO) aims to localize geospatial concepts described in natural language rather than fixed labels. Existing benchmarks typically have narrow category vocabularies or limited query types. To address this, OVEarth-Bench expands evaluation by broadening category coverage with hierarchical categories including positive and negative expressions, and diversifying queries across vocabulary, referring, and reasoning types. It supports mask and box localization under a unified zero-shot protocol. Evaluations show: (1) current methods have limited performance, with broader category coverage yielding more stable model rankings; (2) MLLM-based methods achieve the best overall results; (3) EO-specific methods underperform compared to general models and rarely match the strongest. The findings guide future open-vocabulary EO method development and highlight the need for realistic, diverse, high-quality, large-scale benchmarks for reliable evaluation. Data and code are publicly released.
why_it_matters_zh: 该工作填补了地球观测领域中开放词汇评测的空白，通过扩展类别和查询种类提升评测的全面性和现实性，有助于推动更稳定、优质的EO模型发展。
why_it_matters_en: This work fills a gap in open-vocabulary evaluation for Earth observation by expanding category and query diversity, enhancing comprehensiveness and realism of benchmarks, which supports the development of more stable and high-quality EO models.

title_zh: VETO：保护图像免受前沿AI编辑
title_en: VETO: Towards Protecting Images From Frontier AI Editing
summary_zh: 随着强大且易用的图像编辑模型如FLUX.2的兴起，高保真图像编辑变得更加普及。这些模型的能力不仅限于局部修改，还能将对象和身份提取并重新置于全新场景中。现代模型通过允许提示和生成令牌直接关注参考图像令牌，模糊了传统编辑与文本到图像生成的界限。这种生成自由的扩展也扩大了潜在滥用的空间，恶意的转换不再局限于可预测的局部编辑。现有的反编辑防护设计用于破坏传统扩散模型中参考图像编码的语义瓶颈，但新型编辑器通过联合注意力模块来提取参考信息，常常绕过这些防护。为此，我们提出VETO，一种通过扰乱现代模型读取源图像的内机制的细微反编辑保护。此外，鉴于现有编辑基准主要测试局部编辑，忽视了全面的重新语境化，我们引入VetoBench，评估防护在传统局部编辑和广泛语境变化上的效果。在两种最新编辑模型和三个基准测试中，VETO始终优于现有防护，同时提供更优越的保护与图像质量权衡。
summary_en: The rise of powerful, accessible image-editing models like FLUX.2 has made high-fidelity editing widely available. Their capabilities go beyond simple localized modifications to extracting and recontextualizing objects and identities in entirely new scenes. Modern models allow prompt and generation tokens to directly attend to reference-image tokens, blurring the line between traditional editing and text-to-image synthesis. This wider generative freedom increases the risk of misuse, as harmful edits are no longer confined to predictable local changes. Existing anti-edit defenses disrupt the semantic bottleneck in legacy diffusion pipelines but are often circumvented by newer editors that use joint-attention blocks to distill reference information. To address this, we introduce VETO, a subtle anti-edit cloak that disrupts the inner mechanism through which modern models read source images. We also introduce VetoBench, a benchmark that evaluates defenses on both conventional localized edits and broader contextual shifts. Across two contemporary editing models and three benchmarks, VETO consistently outperforms existing defenses while offering a better protection-fidelity trade-off.
why_it_matters_zh: 随着图像编辑技术的快速进步，传统的防护机制已难以应对新型的联合注意力模型，造成潜在滥用风险增加。VETO通过针对现代编辑模型的内机制设计，提升了图像保护的有效性和实用性，促进了图像版权和隐私的保护。VetoBench的建立，也推动了防护评估的全面化，适应了未来AI编辑技术的发展需求。
why_it_matters_en: As image editing technology rapidly advances, traditional defenses struggle against new joint-attention based models, increasing potential misuse risks. VETO improves protection effectiveness and practicality by targeting the inner mechanisms of modern editors, enhancing image copyright and privacy safeguards. The introduction of VetoBench promotes comprehensive defense evaluation, adapting to future developments in AI editing technologies.

title_zh: Bunraku：将单幅插画转变为可编辑的Live2D角色
title_en: Bunraku: Turning a Single Illustration into an Editable Live2D Character
summary_zh: Live2D是动漫角色和虚拟头像主流的二维角色动画格式，以逐层RGBA图层及其网格变形驱动角色动作。尽管广泛应用于虚拟直播、手游和交互角色，创建Live2D模型仍需数周手动分层、填补遮挡、摆放网格和关键帧制作，且此前无端到端生成方法。本研究首次提出从单张插画生成Live2D运行时所需的所有结构信息：有序RGBA图层、每层变形网格及驱动角色动作的关键帧顶点偏移。第一阶段将层分解视为一种基于Live2D器官级分类的分层扩散过程，生成有序RGBA栈及隐层区域补全；第二阶段仅用alpha通道构建与内容匹配的三角网格，并联合预测所有图层关键帧位移场，通过自注意力跨层边界处理顶点，位移被分解为有界方向和对数幅度。联合预测确保生成连贯角色而非单独合理部分，且网络放大112倍效果无显著提升。对50个留出测试角色，非强制式生成阶段二顶点方向余弦中位数达0.828。网格基于alpha通道，衣物层可通过自然语言指令重贴图，网格与动画无损复用。此外，贡献了首个Live2D标准化基准Live2D-Bench及包含8884模型的带层和动画监督的Live2D数据集。
summary_en: Live2D dominates 2D character animation for anime and virtual avatars, representing each character as layered RGBA frames with mesh deformations. However, creating Live2D models is manual and time-consuming, lacking end-to-end generative solutions. This work introduces Bunraku, the first system to generate all structured data Live2D needs from a single illustration: ordered RGBA layers, per-layer deformation meshes, and parameter-driven keypose vertex offsets. Stage 1 uses a layered diffusion process guided by a Live2D-aware organ taxonomy to produce an ordered RGBA stack with hidden region completion. Stage 2 builds triangle meshes per layer from alpha maps, then jointly predicts keypose displacement fields across all layers using a self-attention mechanism spanning layer boundaries, factorizing displacements into bounded directions and log-magnitudes. Joint prediction ensures coherent character animation rather than plausible isolated parts; scaling network size 112x does not improve results. On 50 held-out characters, stage 2 achieves a median per-vertex direction cosine of 0.828 under true generation without teacher forcing. Meshes derived from alpha allow clothing layers to be re-textured via natural language instructions while reusing meshes and animations exactly. They also release Live2D-Bench, the first standardized benchmark, and an 8,884-model Live2D corpus with layered and animation supervision.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究突破传统手动建模瓶颈，实现了从单幅插画自动生成用于Live2D的完整结构化数据，极大提高二维虚拟角色制作效率和灵活性，推动虚拟直播、游戏和动漫领域的角色创作创新。联合预测关键帧顶点位移保证角色动画连贯性，且支持自然语言驱动服装重贴图，是工业和研究中的重要进展。
why_it_matters_en: This research overcomes the traditional manual modeling bottleneck by automatically generating complete structured data for Live2D from a single illustration, greatly enhancing efficiency and flexibility in 2D virtual character creation. The joint prediction of keypose vertex displacements ensures coherent animations, while natural language-driven clothing re-texturing adds creative versatility. These contributions significantly advance character creation for virtual streaming, gaming, and animation industries.
